blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-language-action models are typically built on a simple premise: perception is first compressed by visual encoders, and action reasoning begins only afterwards. Yet manipulation often hinges on precisely the visual signals most vulnerable to this abstraction, e.g., local geometry, boundaries, depth, and subtle state changes. This raises a fundamental question: should action policies inherit a fixed visual endpoint, or directly access evolving visual computation? We introduce NEO-VLA, a structurally encoder-free vision-language-action framework. Images are tokenized by lightweight patch convolutional layers and evolve jointly with language throughout the backbone, allowing a flow-matching action expert to draw from instruction-conditioned visual representations at different depths. This simple change reveals a consistent pattern. Native architectures outperform encoder-based counterparts under controlled comparisons; full fine-tuning reduces but does not erase the gap, and additional scale alone cannot recover it. More strikingly, layer-wise probing shows that the action-critical signals often peak well before the final visual representation. Across diverse manipulation settings and distribution shifts, NEO-VLA consequently achieves stronger and more robust control. Together, these results suggest that embodied control benefits from access to visual representations across the computational hierarchy, rather than a fixed encoder output.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言-动作模型一般建立在简单的前提上:感知首先被视觉编码器压缩,动作推理只在之后才开始. 然而,操纵往往取决于最容易受到这种抽象影响的视觉信号,例如局部几何、边界、深度和微妙的状态变化。 这就提出了一个根本性的问题:行动政策是继承固定的视觉终点,还是直接访问不断发展的视觉计算? 我们介绍了近地天体甚低频轨道,这是一个结构上无编码的视觉语言行动框架。 图像以轻量级补丁折叠层为标志,并在整个骨干中与语言共同演化,使流配动作专家能够从不同深度的指令性有条件的视觉表现中提取. 这种简单的改变揭示了一种一贯的模式. 原生架构在受控比较下优于基于编码器的对应方;完全微调缩小但不能消除差距,单靠额外尺度无法恢复. 更引人注目的是,分层探测显示,动作临界信号往往在最终视觉表现之前就达到顶峰. 因此,在各种操纵设置和分布变化中,近地物体甚高分辨率飞行器实现了更有力和更强有力的控制。 这些结果加在一起表明,从整个计算层次的视觉表现,而不是从固定编码器输出中获取所体现控制的好处。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Robotic manipulation demands both semantic understanding and fine-grained spatial reasoning. A policy must identify what an instruction refers to, infer where the target lies, and determine how the gripper should move relative to it. This raises a fundamental question for vision-language-action (VLA) models: should action prediction rely only on the final visual representation, or also on the intermediate visual computation?
blocks.zh: 机器人操纵需要语义理解和精细的空间推理. 政策必须确定一项指示指的是什么,推断目标所在,并确定控制者应如何相对地移动。 这对视觉语言-动作模型(VLA)提出了一个根本性的问题:动作预测是只依靠最终的视觉表现,还是还要依靠中间视觉计算?

blocks.en:
Most existing VLAs make this choice implicitly. Images are first compressed by pretrained vision encoders, such as CLIP, SigLIP, or DINOv2 ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Zhai et al., 2023 ; Oquab et al., 2023 ) , before the resulting features are passed to the language backbone and action model ( Brohan et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Black et al., 2024 ; Bjorck et al., 2025 ) .
This interface exposes the encoder output while hiding the visual hierarchy that produced it.
Growing evidence suggests that this separation may constrain embodied control: visual processing is critical to VLA performance ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , visual components are disproportionately sensitive to pruning ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) , and action fine-tuning can degrade pretrained visual representations ( Kachaev et al., 2025 ) .
We instead reconsider the interface itself, enabling action prediction to directly exploit the evolving visual representations within the backbone.
blocks.zh:
多数现有自愿职业介绍所都含蓄地作出这一选择。 图像首先由CLIP,SigLIP等预受训练的视觉编码器或DINOv2等(拉德福德等,2021;Zhai等,2023;Oquab等,2023)进行压缩后,所形成的特性才被传递到语言骨干和动作模型上(Brohan等,2023;Kim等,2024;Black等,2024;Bjorck等,2025.).
这个接口暴露了编码器输出,同时隐藏了产生它的视觉分级.
越来越多的证据表明,这种分离可能约束了被包含的控制:视觉处理对VLA的性能至关重要(Zhang等,2026b),视觉组件对普鲁士的超度敏感(Zhang等,2026a),动作微调可降解被事先训练的视觉表现. (Kachaev等,2025年).
相反,我们重新考虑接口本身,使行动预测能够直接利用骨干内部不断变化的视觉表现。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Three VLA designs : encoder-based vs. encoder-free backbones, and discrete vs. continuous actions. (a) A separate visual encoder converts pixels into image features, which are consumed by the language backbone together with text tokens; actions are generated as discrete tokens. (b) The same encoder-based visual interface is retained, while a separate action head predicts continuous actions conditioned on the backbone. (c) NEO-VLA removes the separately pretrained visual encoder: a lightweight patch embedder maps pixels directly into the backbone token space, while text tokens enter the backbone jointly. A narrow action expert then reads cached keys and values from selected backbone layers and predicts a flow-matching velocity field.
blocks.zh: 图1: 三相VLA设计:基于编码器对无编码器主干线,离散对连续动作. (a) 一个单独的视觉编码器将像素转换为图像特性,这些特性被语言主干线与文本符号一起消耗;动作作为离散符号生成. (b) 保留同样的以编码器为基础的视觉接口,而单独的动作头则预测以主干线为条件的连续动作. (c) NEO-VLA移除了单独预装的视觉编码器:一个轻量级补丁嵌入像素的地图直接进入主干标志空间,而文本符号则共同进入主干线。 一个狭义的动作专家然后从所选的主干层读取缓存的密钥和值并预测出一个流相匹配的速度场.

blocks.en:
We introduce NEO-VLA, a structurally native VLA policy built directly on pixels and words, requiring no separately pretrained vision encoder, image codebook, or autoencoder.
Following encoder-free models ( Bavishi et al., 2023 ; Diao et al., 2024 ; Diao et al., 2025 ; Diao et al., 2026a ; Diao et al., 2026c ) , a lightweight convolutional patch embedder maps raw pixels into the backbone token space, where image patches and instruction words are processed jointly within a single holistic architecture in Figure 1 . A flow-matching action expert then reads cached keys and values from diverse backbone layers with different representation hierarchies to predict continuous action chunks.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了近地物体-甚高频雷达,这是一种结构上原生的甚高频雷达政策,它直接建立在像素和文字上,不需要经过单独培训的视觉编码器、图像编码器或自动编码器。
遵循无编码模型(Bavishi等,2023;Diao等,2024;Diao等,2025;Diao等,2026a;Diao等,2026c),一个轻量级的平板嵌入式原始像素地图入骨干标志空间,其中图像补丁和指令词在图1中在一个单一的整体架构内联合处理. 流程匹配动作专家然后读取来自不同骨干层的缓存键和值,具有不同的表示分级,以预测连续动作块.

blocks.en: This design makes visual readout depth an explicit policy choice: the action expert can draw from early, late, or multiple stages of visual computation without introducing a separate visual pathway. In conventional encoder-based VLAs, by contrast, accessing different language-backbone layers still places the policy downstream of a fixed visual endpoint. NEO-VLA thus enables a direct investigation of where action-relevant visual information emerges and which stages of visual computation are most valuable for control.
blocks.zh: 这种设计使得视觉读取深度是一个明确的政策选择:动作专家可以从视觉计算的早期,后期或多阶段取出,而不引入单独的视觉路径. 相形之下,在基于常规编码器的VLA中,访问不同的语言后骨层仍然将政策置于固定视觉终点下游. 因此,近地物体-甚高分辨率飞行器能够直接调查与行动有关的视觉信息的出现地点和视觉计算的各个阶段对控制最有价值。

blocks.en: Our analysis reveals a clear depth-dependent pattern. With the backbone frozen, readouts that include early layers consistently outperform those restricted to later representations; after full fine-tuning, combining early and late features performs best. Targeted interventions lead to the same conclusion: swapping early-layer activations across observations induces substantially larger prediction errors than perturbing later layers. Together, these results indicate that action-critical information emerges well before the final representations, when fine-grained spatial and geometric cues remain more directly accessible. Preserving access to these intermediate computations therefore provides a strong basis for precise and generalizable control.
blocks.zh: 我们的分析揭示了一种明显的深度依赖模式。 随着骨干被冻结,包括早期层在内的读取内容一直比仅限于后期表达内容的读取内容要好;经过全面微调后,早期和后期功能的结合效果最好. 有针对性的干预导致得出同样的结论:在观测中互换早期激活会导致比扰扰后层大得多的预测错误. 这些结果表明,关键行动信息早在最后表述之前就已出现,而精细的空间和几何提示仍然比较直接。 因此,保留获取这些中间计算的机会为准确和普遍的控制提供了坚实的基础。

blocks.en: We further compare NEO-VLA with Qwen3-VL-2B and Gemma-3-4B, which offer comparable understanding capabilities, using the same action expert and robot-training corpus. NEO-VLA consistently achieves higher LIBERO success rates under both frozen-backbone and full-finetuning settings, with the advantage particularly pronounced when the backbone is frozen and policy learning must rely directly on pretrained visual representations. Although differences in pretraining and model capacity preclude attributing the gains solely to encoder removal, these results establish the native backbone as a strong and transferable foundation for action learning.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步将近地物体-甚高分辨率飞行器与Qune3-VL-2B和Gemma-3-4B进行了比较,它们利用同样的动作专家和机器人训练仪提供了类似的理解能力。 近地物体-甚高分辨率飞行器在冷冻后骨和全平整设置下都不断取得更高的LIBERO成功率,当主干被冷冻时其优势特别明显,政策学习必须直接依靠经过预先训练的视觉表现。 虽然在培训前和示范能力方面的差异排除了将收益完全归因于去除编码,但这些成果将本土骨干作为行动学习的坚实而可转让的基础。

blocks.en: We then evaluate NEO-VLA on LIBERO, LIBERO-plus, and RoboTwin 2.0, covering both standard manipulation and challenging distribution shifts in visual appearance, language, and environment. NEO-VLA achieves strong in-distribution performance while maintaining robust control under these shifts, with particularly pronounced gains under camera perturbations and image noise. These results complement the layer-wise analysis by showing that preserving access to intermediate visual computation is not only useful in controlled ablations, but also translates into practical robustness across diverse manipulation settings. Taken together, our findings point to a broader principle for embodied intelligence: effective control depends not only on what the backbone represents, but also on which stages of its visual computation remain accessible to action.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们评价LIBERO、LIBERO-plus和RoboTwin 2.0上的近地天体甚高分辨率轨道,涵盖视觉外观、语言和环境的标准操纵和具有挑战性的分布变化。 近地物体-甚高分辨率飞行器在传播过程中取得了强劲的性能,同时在这些变化中保持了强有力的控制,在相机扰动和图像噪音下取得了特别显著的进展。 这些结果补充了分层分析,表明保留对中间视觉计算的访问不仅在受控浮出水面中有用,而且转化为不同操纵环境的实用稳健性. 综合起来,我们的调查结果指出一个更广泛的包含情报的原则:有效的控制不仅取决于骨干代表什么,而且取决于其视觉计算的各个阶段仍然可以采取行动。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Existing VLA policies typically attach an action decoder to a pretrained vision-language
model. Early systems emit actions as discrete text tokens ( Brohan et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2024 ) , while later work uses continuous diffusion or
flow-matching decoders over backbone features ( Black et al., 2024 ; Intelligence et al., 2025 ; Bjorck et al., 2025 ) ; Team et al. (2024) instead trains a
transformer policy from scratch with a diffusion head.
Our design differs along two axes:
whether the visual pathway introduces a separately pretrained vision encoder, and whether
actions are represented discretely or continuously.
Most prior work has focused on the action side while leaving the visual pathway
largely unchanged.
Images are commonly processed by pretrained encoders such as CLIP, SigLIP, or
DINOv2 ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Zhai et al., 2023 ; Oquab et al., 2023 ) , often at a fixed resolution and
sometimes with the encoder frozen during policy training.
Recent studies suggest that this front end can limit control: Zhang et al. (2026b) identify the visual module as a major bottleneck, Zhang et al. (2026a) find the vision encoder, language backbone, and
projector among the components most sensitive to pruning, and Kachaev et al. (2025) show that action finetuning can degrade visual
representations.
Recent unified systems also tend to preserve the visual front end, adding
modality-specific experts for generation, foresight, or world modelling above a
shared attention stream ( Liang et al., 2024 ; Cai et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Lv et al., 2025 ; Qu et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2026 ; Cen et al., 2025 ; Liang et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . Zhang et al. (2026c) instead adds a second visual pathway, arguing that one encoder
may not serve both language grounding and control well.
Our focus is different: we vary the visual pathway itself while keeping the action expert, the layers it reads, the training data.

A separate line of work removes the vision encoder itself, mapping pixels through a lightweight learned patch embedder directly into the language backbone ( Bavishi et al., 2023 ; Diao et al., 2024 ; Diao et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Diao et al., 2026a ; Diao et al., 2026c ; Diao et al., 2026d ; Diao et al., 2026b ; Lab, 2026 ) .
In this literature, native can refer to different ideas: removing a separate vision module, training multimodally from the start ( Tong et al., 2026 ; Han et al., 2026 ) , or preserving the backbone’s original
format and objectives during policy training ( Ma et al., 2026 ) .
We use the term only in the structural sense: no separately trained vision
module, image codebook, or autoencoder.
Control models have evolved along related lines. Wang et al. (2026) represent vision, language, and action as unified discrete token sequences, and Xie et al. (2026) replace the transformer-based vision encoder with a convolutional alternative.
Concurrent work studies understanding and generation without a separately
trained vision module ( Wu et al., 2026 ) .
Our focus is narrower: we compare visual pathways under a matched action expert
and study which backbone depths the expert should read.

blocks.en: 3.1 Structurally native visual interface
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 结构上本地视觉界面

blocks.en: Following NEO ( Diao et al., 2026a ) , NEO-VLA adopts a structurally native visual interface that projects raw images directly into the backbone token space through a lightweight two-stage convolutional embedder with an overall stride of 32 32 , producing one visual token for each 32 × 32 32\times 32 image region. Visual and language tokens are then jointly processed throughout the decoder backbone, while continuous actions are generated by a flow-matching expert, avoiding explicit action tokenization.
blocks.zh: 继近地物体(Diao等,2026a)之后,近地物体-VLA采用了一个结构上原生的视觉界面,通过一个轻量级的两相相接嵌入器将原始图像直接投射入主干标志空间,整体走行部为32-32,每32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相32相1相接. 视觉和语言符号随后在整个解码器主干线上进行联合处理,而连续动作则由流相匹配专家生成,避免了明显的动作符号化.

blocks.en: Besides, we employ Native Rotary Position Embedding ( Diao et al., 2026a ) to factorize positions into temporal, height, and width coordinates with decoupled rotary frequencies. Note that image tokens retain explicit two-dimensional spatial coordinates, while videos additionally advance along the temporal axis, enabling a unified treatment of images, videos, and interleaved multimodal sequences.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们使用原始扶轮姿势嵌入(Diao等人,2026a),将姿势纳入时间、高度和宽度坐标,并使用已脱钩的回旋频率。 请注意,图像符号保留明确的二维空间坐标,而视频则沿着时间轴进一步推进,从而能够统一处理图像、视频和互放多模式序列。

blocks.en: The backbone further adopts modality-aware multimodal attention: text tokens follow causal attention, while visual tokens interact bidirectionally within each visual block. This enables dense spatial modeling while visual and linguistic representations co-evolve across layers. Consequently, the action expert can read from different stages of the visual hierarchy from fine-grained early features to more semantic later representations, rather than being restricted to a single, fixed encoder output.
blocks.zh: 骨干进一步采用有模式意识的多模式关注:文本指使遵循因果关注,而视觉指使则在每个视觉块内双向互动. 这样可以进行密集的空间建模,而视觉和语言表现则可以共同进行分层演化. 因此,动作专家可以从视觉分级的不同阶段读取从精细的早期特征到更能语义化的后期表达,而不是局限于单一的固定编码器输出.

blocks.en: Notably, we train the 40-layer encoder-free vision-language backbone with 2B parameters through three-stage training. We first establish visual perception through large-scale image-text pretraining while preserving the linguistic capabilities of the pretrained language model. Mid-training then deepens vision-language alignment using diverse captioning, conversation, OCR, and detection data, followed by supervised instruction tuning on high-quality multimodal interactions. This gradually advances the model from multimodal perception to reasoning, yielding a strong foundation for downstream action learning.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,我们通过三阶段培训,用2B参数培训40层无编码的视觉语言主干。 我们首先通过大规模图像文本预训建立视觉感知,同时保留被预训语言模型的语言能力. 中期培训然后利用不同的标题、对话、OCR和检测数据来深化视觉语言的一致,然后对高质量的多模式互动进行监督指导。 这逐渐将模式从多式联运观念推向推理,为下游行动学习奠定了坚实的基础。

blocks.en: 3.2 Multimodal prefix
blocks.zh: 3.2 多式联运前缀

blocks.en: In Figure 2 , NEO-VLA converts robot observations into a unified multimodal prefix composed of previous and current multi-view images, structured language, and robot states. Each temporal block contains up to three camera views, with every view represented by a camera-identity token, projected camera geometry, and patch-level visual tokens. Camera intrinsics and rotations are encoded by lightweight geometry MLPs, while a single patch embedder is shared across all cameras, views, and time steps. Images preserve their native aspect ratios and are dynamically patchified under a fixed budget of up to 88 visual tokens per view, with padded positions masked from attention. This design keeps the visual pathway fully native: pixels enter the language backbone directly, without an external vision transformer, autoencoder, or discrete visual tokenizer.
blocks.zh: 在图2中,近地物体-VLA将机器人观测转换为由以前和目前的多视图图像、结构化语言和机器人状态所组成的统一的多模式前缀。 每个时段块包含最多3个相机视图,每个视图由相机识别符代表,投影相机几何,和补丁级可视符号. 相机的内在和自转由轻量级几何MLP编码而来,而一个单一的补丁嵌入器则在所有相机,视图,和时间步骤上共享. 图像保持其原生侧面比例,并在每道视线高达88个可视符号的固定预算下动态地补齐,并遮住被注意的外加位置. 这种设计使视觉路径完全本土化:像素直接输入语言主干线,没有外部视觉变压器,自发编码器,或离散的视觉活化器.

blocks.en: The visual blocks are followed by a structured prompt specifying the control frequency, robot embodiment, gripper configuration, action-frame reference, and task instruction. Robot proprioception is represented by six additional tokens corresponding to the previous and current states of Arm 0, Arm 1, and the shared body. State MLPs jointly encode the measured values and their validity masks, while additive embeddings identify temporal role and arm/body identity. Components absent from a particular embodiment are simply masked, allowing the same token interface to accommodate different robot configurations.
blocks.zh: 视觉块后会有一个结构化的提示来指定控制频率,机器人的化身,抓取器的配置,动作框参考,以及任务指示. 机器人自发由前作和现作的Arma 0,Arma 1和同体对应的另外6个符号来代表. 国家MLP联合编码所测值及其有效性口罩,而添加剂嵌入物则识别出时间作用和臂/体身份. 某个特定化身中缺失的组件只是被遮住,允许相同的同物接口来容纳不同的机器人配置.

blocks.en: All prefix tokens are processed jointly by the native backbone using three-dimensional rotary positions over time, height, and width. Visual tokens from the same image share a temporal coordinate, while their spatial coordinates follow the corresponding patch grid; text and state tokens advance along the temporal axis with zero spatial coordinates. Rather than collapsing this computation into a single final visual representation, NEO-VLA exposes the layer-wise keys and values of the backbone directly to a lightweight action expert. The expert then combines this multimodal prefix with noisy action tokens and flow time τ \tau , augmented by step, frame, and identity embeddings, to model action chunks for both arms and the body. The three action blocks share temporal rotary offsets over the prediction horizon, while identity embeddings distinguish their semantic roles. Note that the expert predicts a unified velocity field over the continuous action trajectory.
blocks.zh: 所有前缀符号由本土骨干共同处理,使用三维回转姿势随时间,高度,宽度而变化. 同一图像的可视标志共享一个时间坐标,而其空间坐标遵循相应的补丁网格;文本和状态标志沿时间轴前进,空间坐标为零. 近地物体-甚高分辨率飞行器没有将计算结果变成单一的最后视觉表现,而是将主干线的分层键和值直接暴露给轻量级行动专家。 然后,专家将这个多式前缀与响亮的动作符号和相通时间\tau合并,再由步骤、框和身份嵌入来补充,以模拟武器和身体的动作块。 这三个动作块在预测地平线上共享时间回转抵消,而身份嵌入则区分出它们的语义作用. 请注意,专家预测在连续动作轨迹上有一个统一的速度场。

blocks.en: 4.3 Training Details
blocks.zh: 4.3 培训细节

blocks.en: Our training recipe has three progressive stages. In stage 1 , we freeze the pretrained vision-language backbone and train the action expert and conditioning modules. This stage uses 113,400 optimizer steps, a global batch size of 8192, and a peak learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} . In stage 2 , we unfreeze the full model and continue training on the same robot pretrain corpus for 75,000 steps with the same batch size. The action expert and conditioning modules use a peak learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , while the vision-language parameters use 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} . We co-train with multi-modal understanding data to retain vision-language perception and reasoning capabilities. Packed understanding examples are added on every other optimizer step, with an auxiliary next-token prediction loss weighted by 0.1 on those steps. In stage 3 , we continue the full-parameter finetune initialized from stage-2 with our in-house action data for another 75,000 steps with the same batch size, all the other settings are consistent with stage-2. Both stages use AdamW with β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 , β 2 = 0.95 \beta_{2}=0.95 , ϵ = 10 − 8 \epsilon=10^{-8} and weight decay 10 − 10 10^{-10} . Learning rates increase linearly over 2,000 warmup steps, then follow cosine decay to 10% of their respective peaks. We use bfloat16 mixed precision and clip the gradient norm at 1.0.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5个实验

blocks.en: We organize the experiments around four questions. First, what does a native-input backbone bring over encoder-based ones under matched settings ( 5.1 )? Second, which depths does the action expert read, and what does it extract from them ( 5.2 )? Third, how does retaining multimodal understanding affect action learning ( 5.3 )? Finally, how does NEO-VLA perform on in- and out-of-distribution benchmarks ( 5.4 )?
blocks.zh: 我们围绕四个问题组织实验。 首先,一个本地输入的骨干在匹配的设置(5.1)下带给基于编码器的骨干是什么? 第二,行动专家读到哪些深度,从中提取什么(5.2)? 第三,保留多式联运理解如何影响行动学习(5.3)? 最后,近地物体-甚高分辨率飞行器如何执行分配基准(5.4)?

Direct access to visual features alone does not reproduce this advantage.
In a separate Qwen3-VL experiment, we route 13 expert layers to
intermediate vision-tower features. Table 3 compares this interface under the same setting. Encoder access lowers frozen-backbone performance from 79.5% to 64.9%, while full fine-tuning brings the two interfaces to similar scores, 90.9% and 90.8%. These results highlight the importance of how representations are presented to, and aligned with, demonstrating that the action expert only access to the intermediate features is not sufficient. Taken together, the results support a practical contribution of NEO’s native backbone: its low-level representations that transfer well to action related tasks naturally, while retaining room for improvement through full fine-tuning.

blocks.en: LIBERO-Plus ( Fei et al., 2025 ) provides a more informative view by evaluating seven types of distribution shift separately. As shown in Table 5 , NEO-VLA achieves an overall score of 89.7, the highest among models in the table with both code and weights publicly available. Its robustness is particularly strong under camera and language perturbations, reaching 94.5 and 91.7, respectively. The gains are less pronounced under robot and layout changes, which alter the embodiment or scene configuration rather than the visual observation itself. This suggests that NEO-VLA is especially robust to changes in how the scene is perceived, rather than to all forms of distribution shift. This pattern is consistent with the layer analysis in Section 5.2 , where the action expert relies heavily on early visual representations.
blocks.zh: LIBERO-Plus(Fei等,2025年)通过分别评价7类分布转移,提供了更丰富的观点. 如表5所示,近地物体甚高分辨率飞行器的总得分为89.7分,是表中既有代码又有加权值的模型中最高的。 在相机和语言扰动下其稳健性特别强,分别达到94.5和91.7. 这些收益在机器人和布局变化下不太明显,这些变化改变了外观或场景配置,而不是视觉观察本身. 这表明,近地物体-甚高分辨率飞行器对场景感知方式的变化,而不是对所有形式的分布转移,特别有力。 这种模式与第5.2节中的分层分析是一致的,在该节中,行动专家严重依赖早期的视觉表现.

blocks.en: ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) probes generalization under four distinct perturbations: object appearance, object position, instruction semantics, and task goals. As shown in Table 8 , NEO-VLA performs particularly well under semantic variation, achieving 98.0, the highest score in the table. It also remains competitive under object changes, but degrades substantially when object positions or task goals are altered. This contrast is informative: NEO-VLA is robust to changes in visual appearance and instruction wording, yet still struggles when successful execution requires adapting to unfamiliar spatial configurations or action goals. Together with the LIBERO-Plus results, this suggests that the native backbone provides strong perceptual and semantic robustness, while flexible spatial and task-level adaptation remains a key challenge.

blocks.en: 5.5.2 Evaluation Results
blocks.zh: 5.5.2 评价结果

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 10 , we compare NEO-VLA with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ( Intelligence et al., 2025 ) and StarVLA ( StarVLA Community, 2026 ) using the same real-world training data and each method’s recommended post-training setup. Task 1 and Task 3 emphasize precise object interaction and placement, while Task 2 requires sustained long-horizon execution across multiple sequential manipulation steps. NEO-VLA achieves the strongest overall performance after the same fine-tuning process, with success rates of 12/20, 17/20, and 13/20 across three real-world tasks. It substantially outperforms StarVLA and matches or exceeds π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} in every setting, despite its smaller model scale.
More importantly, NEO-VLA maintains strong performance when object configurations deviate from those seen during training, indicating that the learned policy captures transferable visual-action structure rather than simply memorizing demonstrated layouts. The qualitative examples in Figure 6 further illustrate this capability across diverse interaction patterns, including precise placement, object reorientation, sequential manipulation, and multi-step execution. Taken together, these results show that the native VLA design transfers effectively to real-world control, supporting both fine-grained manipulation and long-horizon behavior under limited real-world supervision, while retaining robustness to changes in the observed scene.

Table 11: Inference latency summary. We report milliseconds per query on one RTX 3090 in BF16, with raw 30-step chunks.
blocks.zh: 表11:推断延迟摘要。 BF16的1个RTX 3090的查询报告为毫秒,有30步的原始块。

We also measure latency on the real robot (pika), with the policy served on a single NVIDIA RTX 3090 (24 GB) in bf16. Each query returns one raw 30-step action chunk, which we execute as predicted without real-time chunking ( Black et al., 2026 ) . Table 11 reports our default of 10 Euler steps and, for reference, a 2-step setting.
With 10 steps, a compiled forward pass takes 282.5 ms. Most of it goes to the action expert, whose 10 Euler steps take 163.4 ms. The backbone prefix pass takes 84.8 ms and runs only once per query, since every step reuses its key–value cache. The convolutional patch embedder costs 3.1ms. Compiling the backbone and expert layers with torch.compile , together with caching the conditioning inputs within each request, cuts the forward pass from 515.4 to 282.5ms and changes predicted positions by at most 0.002cm. On the robot, a query takes 261.9 ms from request to the returned chunk, and 286.2ms until an executable plan is ready after inverse kinematics. Cutting sampling to 2 steps shortens the expert to 32.4ms and the full query to 178.5ms, so the prefix pass becomes the main cost. Fewer steps also change the sampled actions; note that all success rates in Table 10 use 10 steps.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
NEO-VLA challenges a common assumption in modern VLA design: that action should operate on visual representations already distilled for semantic understanding. Our results instead suggest that effective control benefits from retaining access to the visual computation before it collapses into a final semantic representation. A native backbone is already highly transferable to action when frozen, early-layer access is consistently valuable, and simply exposing an encoder-based VLM to intermediate visual features does not recover the same benefit. This indicates that what matters is not encoder removal alone, but how visual representations are formed and exposed to the policy throughout the backbone.
The broader picture is equally revealing. NEO-VLA is highly robust when the appearance or observation of a scene changes, yet remains challenged when the spatial configuration or task goal itself changes. This asymmetry suggests that the next bottleneck in embodied intelligence may no longer be perception alone, but converting perceptual understanding into flexible action under changing geometry and intent. We therefore view native VLA modeling as a step toward representations that are not only semantically meaningful, but intrinsically useful for control.
blocks.zh:
近地物体-甚高分辨率飞行器对现代甚高分辨率飞行器设计中的一项共同假设提出了挑战:即该动作应运行在已经为语义理解而蒸馏的视觉表现上。 我们的结果表明,在视觉计算崩溃为最后语义表述之前,保留对视觉计算的访问,是有效控制的好处。 当被冻结时,原生主干线已经高度可转移用于行动,早期接入一直具有价值,简单地将基于编码器的VLM暴露于中间视觉特征并不能恢复同样的好处. 这表明,重要的不仅仅是去除编码器,而是视觉表现如何形成和暴露在整个骨干中的政策.
更广阔的画面同样具有启发性。 当某一场景的外观或观测发生变化时,近地天体甚高分辨率超强,但在空间配置或任务目标本身发生变化时,近地天体甚高分辨率超强。 这种不对称现象表明,所体现智能的下个瓶颈可能不再仅仅是感知,而是在变化的几何和意向下将知觉理解转化为灵活行动. 因此,我们认为,以当地VLA为模式,是朝着不仅具有象征意义而且对控制具有内在作用的表述迈出的一步。
